g.text: Preconditions: Student is signed in and authorized; parking policies are configured.
Service calls use the signed-in Student's identity.
End this attempt without a booking; retry after data is available.
Default increment: 15 minutes. Parking interval = [arrival, departure).
Every covered slot needs capacity. Count occupancy, overlapping holds and unavailable
spaces without double-counting. Offer arrivals with at least one feasible departure.
[valid inputs and at least one slot unavailable]
[read failed, no feasible choices or invalid inputs]
End this attempt; revise Hub/dates/times or retry, then refresh choices and revalidate.
No reservation or partial allocation. Student may revise or leave.
If another Hub is selected, start a revised attempt with the same interval.
Refresh time choices and validate the entire request again.
Create ONE Confirmed reservation and all covered holds together, or none.
Serialize conflicting capacity claims; no overbooking or partial allocation.
If final capacity is unavailable, UC-X01 follows the same interaction above on request.
All revised requests need fresh choices, full validation and confirmation.
Smart E-Mobility Hub | Submission 2 | Parking & Private EVs
Thin rectangle: execution of a responsibility; nested rectangle: nested execution
Solid arrow: request / action | Dashed arrow: returned result
Activation ends before waiting for Student input. Read guards top to bottom.
critical: required consistency boundary; updates are all-or-none as noted
